title: Cost-based variable selection for prediction models
abstract: arXiv:2610.37353v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Objective: Variable selection for clinical prediction models is commonly done on statistical grounds related to model fit. Statistical approaches ignore the cost of misclassifications and the harm of measuring a variable. We aim to develop a decision-analytic variable selection algorithm based on net benefit. Materials and Methods: The proposed algorithm selects the set of predictors by exhaustively comparing the net benefit of all combinations using cross validation, with an extension based on backward elimination for settings with many predictors. Variables are selected if the increased net benefit from better predictiveness exceeds the net benefit reduction from the harm of variable measurement. Harm includes financial expense, time, resource allocation, and patient burden. We illustrate the algorithm through a simulated example and three real case studies. We compare its performance to traditional backward elimination and LASSO. Re

translated_title: 基于成本的预测模型变量选择
translated_abstract: 目标：临床预测模型的变量选择通常基于与模型拟合相关的统计学准则。统计方法忽略了误分类的成本以及测量变量本身的危害。我们旨在开发一种基于净收益的决策分析变量选择算法。材料与方法：所提出的算法通过使用交叉验证穷举比较所有变量组合的净收益来选择预测变量集合，并针对预测变量较多的场景提供了一种基于向后消除法的扩展方法。当更好的预测性所带来的净收益增加超过测量该变量危害所导致的净收益减少时，该变量将被纳入。危害包括经济费用、时间、资源分配以及患者负担。我们通过一个模拟示例和三个真实案例研究对该算法进行了说明，并将其性能与传统的向后消除法和LASSO进行了比较。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于净收益的决策分析变量选择算法，在临床预测模型构建中综合考虑变量预测能力提升带来的收益与测量该变量的危害（费用、时间、资源和患者负担），相比传统的向后消除法和LASSO等统计方法更符合临床决策需求。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decision-analytic variable selection algorithm based on net benefit for clinical prediction models, which selects predictors by weighing the net benefit gain from improved predictiveness against the harm of variable measurement (financial cost, time, resources, and patient burden), outperforming traditional statistical methods like backward elimination and LASSO.
